title: Website updates are now kept in sync
summary:
A small bit of garden maintenance: the website update flow now stays in sync.

The website update flow was synced up, keeping the public-facing site aligned as the project evolves.

highlights.title: Massive Model Update
highlights.text: Added support for `Kimi K2 Thinking`, `Gemini Large`, `DeepSeek V3.1`, `Grok 4 Fast`, and `GPT-5 Nano`. Try them in the [Text API](https://enter.pollinations.ai).

highlights.title: Multimodal Audio API
highlights.text: Full support for OpenAI's Audio API features, including `input_audio` and mixed text/audio generation modalities.

highlights.title: Vote for Models
highlights.text: You can now vote on which AI models we should add next directly in the pricing dashboard.
